body: It is recommended not to remove `symbol` and `style` as per the discussion in https://github.com/starship/starship/discussions/1116#discussioncomment-6579 .

API has changed in upstream `feat/format-string` branch.

Here is an example: https://github.com/starship/starship/pull/1063/files
Thanks, I have rebased against that branch.
I have restored `symbol` and `style` to match the new conventions.
